group.title: Gateway firmware notice
group.passage:
Release note: Gateway firmware 4.2

Version 4.2 improves recovery after a brief loss of network connection. It does not change the device’s wireless range. The update is approved for hardware revisions B and C only. Revision A units must remain on version 3.8.

Before installation, export the current configuration. The update preserves normal settings, but the exported file is required if a rollback becomes necessary. The gateway will restart twice; keep power connected until the green status light remains on. Installation normally takes six minutes. If it exceeds fifteen minutes, contact technical support instead of repeatedly disconnecting power.
group.passageZh:
發行說明：閘道器韌體 4.2

4.2 版改善網路短暫斷線後的恢復能力，不改變設備的無線涵蓋範圍。此更新僅核准用於 B、C 硬體版本；A 版設備必須維持 3.8 版韌體。

安裝前請匯出目前設定。更新會保留一般設定，但若必須回復舊版，就需要匯出的檔案。閘道器會重新啟動兩次；請保持供電，直到綠色狀態燈持續亮起。安裝通常需要六分鐘。如果超過十五分鐘，請聯絡技術支援，不要反覆切斷電源。
